mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 52 degrees and clear at Verona City Hall under a First Quarter moon. The temperature will dip to an overnight low of 42 degrees, and we are not expecting any rain tonight.

The City of Verona has two updates for you. First, property owners can now apply for the Stormwater Utility Credit by using systems like rain barrels to protect our local watershed. Second, the Police Department is currently not hiring, but they are accepting resumes from certified officers who wish to join their team in the future.

You have plenty of ways to stay busy. Today you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking toward tomorrow, you have several trivia options including Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus pizza and a pitcher specials at Lake Lou-ee.

In police news, on Thursday, October 15, officers arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving. No students were injured during the incident, and the department is continuing to investigate.
Culver's is currently open until 10 PM tonight. While the specific flavor of the day is not listed, it is always a great time to stop by for a snack before they close for the night.
